changes: Sub-user settings now offer Single-entry cashbook or Double-entry journal, with simplified and full double-entry forms.
Cashbooks show one saved entry per row and separate views for each assigned account, retaining receipt IDs and references.
Negative reconciliation balances remain editable, including a minus sign and an empty field.
Receipt-link checks are silent and cached for the session; focus and idle timers no longer repeat network checks.
Post Entry exchange-rate link controls appear only for foreign-currency accounts.
